description:
Latest decisions from the administrative courts' open data (daily mirror),
sorted by date: what a court has just decided (by relevance: `search_case_law`).

All words required (singular or plural); "in double quotes": exact form;
OR/AND/NOT/NEAR in UPPERCASE between two words are operators (NEAR = within
10 words); lowercase words are plain words. Keywords in French: judgments
spell out the full expression, rarely the acronym ("OQTF").

Example: search_recent_admin_decisions(query='"obligation de quitter le territoire"', court="TA59")

Args:
    query: keywords; empty = all decisions of the court
    court: CE | CE-CAA (CE + CAA) | code of a TA or CAA ("TA59",
        "CAA69") | ALL_TA (the 40 TA) | ALL_CAA (the 9 CAA)
    limit: results (one court; max 100)
    limit_per_court: results per court (ALL_TA, ALL_CAA; max 100)
    total_limit: overall cap (ALL_TA, ALL_CAA; 0 = no cap)
    date_min, date_max: YYYY-MM-DD, date of the decision (optional)

court.description: CE | CE-CAA (CE + CAA) | code of a TA or CAA ("TA59", "CAA69") | ALL_TA (the 40 TA) | ALL_CAA (the 9 CAA)
court.title: Court

date_max.description: Date de fin incluse, format AAAA-MM-JJ (ex. « 2024-12-31 »). Vide = pas de borne.
